title: Inbox Triager on a Haiku Budget
oneLiner: Labels, prioritizes, and suggests an action for every email — with skills as packaged procedures and a memory of every sender.

args.subject: SaaS Weekly #204: pricing page teardowns
args.body: This week we tore down ten pricing pages and found the same three mistakes on eight of them. Plus: a new benchmark on trial-to-paid conversion.
